answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The saffron is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the knoll. The design leans on multi-party computation for private attestation. Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short. The crystal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
